title: Levi Saba
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: In Eruvin 97 and Chullin 29b, Rabbi Shimon ben Lakish spoke in his name. In the Jerusalem Talmud, Eruvin 10:2, the reading is Levi Sukhia; likewise there, 10:12, Shimon ben Lakish in the name of Levi Sikhiyya; and Yoma 8:6 has Rabbi Shimon [ben Lakish] in the name of Rabbi Levi Sikhiyya.
In Pesachim 6:1, Shimon ben Lakish speaks in the name of Rabbi Sukhia; it seems that the word Levi is missing in the middle.

notes.text: The forms Sukhia and Sikhiyya are Hyman’s reported variants. His suggestion that Levi is missing from the Pesachim wording remains tentative.
Chullin 29b directly names Rabbi Shimon ben Lakish reporting Levi Saba. The other name forms and the proposed missing Levi remain Hyman’s reports; Eruvin 97 has no supplied amud.
